name: Verify user views list of open tickets via assistant
objective: Validate that the user can ask about their tickets and see a list of open tickets with ticket numbers and statuses.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. User has open tickets in the system.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Verify the assistant displays a list of open tickets
steps.expectedResult: A list of the user's open tickets is displayed

steps.description: Verify each ticket shows ticket number and status
steps.expectedResult: Each ticket in the list shows the ticket number (e.g., INC-12345) and current status (e.g., Open, In Progress)
